name: SwinFace
authors_or_creators: Lixiong Qin, Mei Wang, Chao Deng, Ke Wang, Xi Chen, Jiani Hu, Weihong Deng (Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications; Du Xiaoman Financial)
publication_venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT), 2024 (preprint Aug 2023)
backbone: Swin Transformer (Swin-S / Swin-B variants) shared across multi-task heads
accuracy_affectnet: 61.67% on AffectNet-8 class (Overall accuracy reported in the paper) [uncertain]
accuracy_rafdb: 90.97% Overall accuracy on RAF-DB basic 7-class subset [uncertain]
pretrained_weights_available: yes (released on the official GitHub repository, including Swin-based multi-task checkpoints)
hardware_requirements: Training reported on NVIDIA A100/V100-class GPUs; inference feasible on a single modern GPU [uncertain]
loss_function: Multi-task combination: cross-entropy for face recognition (with margin-based ArcFace-style loss), cross-entropy for expression and attribute classification, regression (MSE/L1) for age estimation, with a Multi-Level Channel Attention (MLCA) module to mitigate task conflicts
training_data_used: MS-Celeb-1M (face recognition); CelebA (40 facial attributes); RAF-DB and AffectNet (expression); IMDB-WIKI / MORPH / UTKFace style age datasets for the age head [uncertain]
pretraining_strategy: supervised-pretrain (Swin Transformer backbone initialized from ImageNet supervised weights, then jointly fine-tuned in a multi-task face analysis framework)
pretraining_corpus: ImageNet-1k (Swin backbone); MS-Celeb-1M used during multi-task face joint training
robustness: Multi-task learning with subnet-level channel attention is reported to improve generalization across face-analysis tasks; explicit Occlusion-RAF-DB / Pose-RAF-DB numbers not reported [uncertain]
explainability: Attention maps from the Swin Transformer and the Multi-Level Channel Attention (MLCA) module provide some interpretability of feature sharing across tasks
